name: FluentEDI
description: 42 deterministic tools for AI agents over HTTP and MCP, free and with no API key. X12 EDI parsing, generation, validation and 997 decoding; GS1 and IBAN-class check digits; timezone and delivery-window arithmetic; cron; JSON repair with error localisation; canonical JSON with CIDv1; Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA signature verification; secret scanning; link checking; endpoint assertion.
